title: Anthropic warns in S-1 of possible RSI threshold

lines: Signal posted: Anthropic's S-1 mentions a possible RSI threshold.

body: Anthropic's amended S-1/A says it may "soon" reach the recursive self-improvement threshold defined by its own Responsible Scaling Policy, a first such acknowledgment in revised risk factors. The filing also shows Q3 revenue of $16.96 billion and $895.4 billion in compute commitm
